Primary, secondary, accent colors respectively: #BDA792; #D4E1E7; #5D685E
Three mandatory visual identifiers: 正面が半円で横に長い半円柱; 左右の下辺に脚3本ずつ; 背の中央を通る幅広いうろこ1列
Pose: 前方を少し下げ、屋根状の曲面を斜め上から見せる。

Style: cohesive hand-drawn 2D fantasy game illustration, clear dark colored contour, restrained three-step cel shading, soft upper-left lighting, appealing natural creature proportions, clean readable form.
Composition: isolated single creature, full body with no cropping. Use an elevated three-quarter view from clearly above the creature so both long straight lower edges are visible. The semi-cylindrical roof body runs diagonally from upper-left rear to lower-right front. Show exactly SIX distinct short legs: three attached to the far/back lower edge and projecting visibly above and behind the roof silhouette, and three attached to the near/front lower edge and projecting below the body. Space each row evenly along the length, and keep all six feet tips visibly separate from each other and the body contour. Do not hide the far row behind the body. Keep the two eyes on the front semicircular end visible. Center the whole creature on a square transparent canvas with the full body, six complete legs and clear margin on every side.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no painted checkerboard, no backdrop, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no diffuse glow. Do not draw the guide image's gray shapes, labels, text, outline, or white background; it communicates only the six-foot placement. The first reference is a failed rendering whose visible leg count is wrong; preserve only its creature material and palette, and correct the leg layout using the second reference as an anatomy-position guide.
Constraints: preserve exact anatomy, all three identifiers and the position of the palette colors; no costume or held tool unless explicitly part of the brief.
Individual forbidden changes: 屋根の棟角; 建築物の瓦目地; 曲がりくねる胴
Avoid: extra creatures, humans, text, letters, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative frame, gradients bleeding into the transparent area, photorealism, 3D render, imitation of an existing character, hidden or overlapping legs.

default.method: 完全透明余白を切り、縦横比を保ち長辺896へLANCZOS縮小、透明1024キャンバス中央配置

pixel.method: 別途imagegen生成されたドット候補から指定整数格子のセル中心を採取し、alpha>=128を二値化。見える範囲を切り、MAXCOVERAGEで32色以下へ無ディザ減色、NEARESTで長辺104以内に調整し、透明128キャンバス中央へ配置。通常絵の縮小は不使用。

grid.sampling: unquantized source RGB and alpha threshold>=128 sampled at requested logical cell centers

operations.palette: MAXCOVERAGE 32 on sampled logical cells, no dithering
operations.resize: NEAREST only on sampled pixel sprite to <=104 extent

pixel.source_grid_note: 1254px生成原本における全セルの厳密な反復ブロックは確認できていない。ここに記す格子中心サンプリングと配置は利用者が許可したpixel仕上げ。完成128px画像の論理ピクセルを保持し、原本が数学的に完全な整数倍nearest enlargementだったとは主張しない。
